reasons.plausibility: Adding a small amount of Ti to MnNiSi-based materials to refine grain structure and maintain magnetocaloric properties is scientifically credible and aligns with known effects of microalloying.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of doped and undoped samples under the same processing conditions and measuring both mechanical and magnetocaloric performance provides a clear, decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis addresses a pressing challenge in improving mechanical properties without compromising the magnetocaloric effect, offering a straightforward experimental path for researchers.
